study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Mao et al., Developmental Cognitive Neuroscience, 2025
study_identification_part.si4_title: Mapping early corpus callosum development to identify neurodevelopmental risk

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Construct sex-specific growth curve (normative) models of corpus callosum morphometrics in children aged 1–6 years, then test whether deviations identify ASD in an independent, different-scanner dataset.

rci1_dataset_name.reason: The reference cohort (Dataset 1) used to build growth curves was collected at Zhejiang Children's Hospital on a single 1.5T Siemens scanner.
rci1_dataset_name.supporting_text: This study utilized two brain imaging datasets collected at Zhejiang Children's Hospital, Zhejiang University... Dataset 1 consists of structural brain images from 295 typically developing children (TDC)...

rci2_hc_n.reason: The paper clearly states that 295 typically developing children from Dataset 1 were used for model construction after quality control.
rci2_hc_n.supporting_text: Dataset 1 (n = 295, TDC) was used to construct growth curve models of corpus callosum morphometrics, focusing on age-related variations and developmental trends.
rci2_hc_n.location: Mao2025.pdf.md: Fig. 1. Overview of the dataset and analysis workflow.

rci3_hc_age.answer: min 1; max 6 years; mean NR; sd NR
rci3_hc_age.reason: The paper consistently states the age range for the healthy controls in Dataset 1 is 1-6 years. However, it does not provide a specific mean and standard deviation for the entire cohort, only breaking it down into 1-year age bins for analysis. Therefore, only the range can be reported.
rci3_hc_age.supporting_text: Dataset 1 consists of structural brain images from 295 typically developing children (TDC), aged 1-6 years, and was used to construct growth curve models of the corpus callosum.

rci4_hc_sex.reason: Table 1 explicitly lists the number of females (138) and males (157) for the total of Dataset 1, which consists of 295 participants. The percentages were calculated from these counts (138/295 and 157/295).

rci5_imaging_modality.reason: Both datasets are high-resolution T1-weighted 3D images (MPRAGE at 1.5T; 3D-TFE at 3T).
rci5_imaging_modality.supporting_text: High-resolution T1-weighted 3D images were acquired using a MPRAGE sequence (Dataset 1)... 3D TFE (Dataset 2).

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Sex-specific corpus callosum growth curves generalized to a different scanner and enabled accurate ASD identification (AUC≈0.95) using deviation-based features.
